column1: # South Park™: The Stick Of Truth™ on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Obsidian's engine on NVN, SDK 4.5.0 (the oldest SDK the host runs), base game 1.0.0 (EUR). game.tsv started as the survey's provisional profile and was
# checked by hand; the memory split is the one the game's own SetHeapSize request needs (see game.tsv).
# On the Xiaomi Pad 5 (21051182G, Snapdragon 860 / Adreno 640, Android 13) on 2026-11-05, played by hand and driven with adb taps:
# the "Press A to Begin" title screen, the opening movie (the game's own Bink decoder: audio through the SDK's audout with 0 underruns), the whole
# character creation (5 steps: skin tone, outfit and its primary/secondary colours, ...) and the opening tutorial in the New Kid's bedroom
# ("Use L to move around the room"), with the on-screen gamepad.
# 30 fps solid (the game's own cap: frame work p50 33.4 ms of the 33.3 ms budget, GPU p50 18.8 ms, 200 draws a frame, replay 6.0 ms, 92 pipelines over
# The device's driver must let the host begin passes: dynamic rendering (Vulkan 1.3) or imageless framebuffers with render pass 2 (Vulkan 1.1 +
# VK_KHR_create_renderpass2). Qualcomm's system driver 512.502.0 on this Adreno 640 has neither (vk_init dies with "passes cannot be begun"), so this port is
# packed with a Turnip build (Mesa 26.0.0, Vulkan 1.3.335; `--vulkan-driver vulkan.ad07xx.so`), with which the device reports BC and ASTC textures, geometry
# shaders, transform feedback and zero-copy pools. A driver with Vulkan 1.3 needs no packing.
# Not tested yet: past the opening tutorial (the game's first real scene), the pause menus, a save, and a controller.
